answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 57857 Country: United Kingdom Title: Validity of Salah with vaginal discharge in undergarments without checking Question: I am a Muslim woman following the Hanafi Madhhab. A few years back I used to pray salah when there was vaginal discharge in my undergarments. I never used to check I used to think if I can't see it then my salah is valid. So I used to pray my salah without cleaning and checking. Do I have to do qadha (repeat) of them salah or do loads of nafl salah? Sometimes I also user to get semen however I still used to pray my namaz without a ghusl bath as I was unsure if it was semen or not. But I did used to change my undergarments and do fresh wudhu whenever I got semen. Answer ID: 57857 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 321/308/H=04/1436) (1) In case the vaginal discharge took place and you did not observe it then you shall not be considered pure rather if you offered salah without washing the place which is smeared with impurity then salah shall not be valid. Thus consider over it and assess the salahs which have been offered in the state of impurity and make its qadha; offering nafl salah instead will not be sufficient , rather it shall remain liable on you. (2) In case the semen discharged with lust then it made ghusl wajib. It was not enough to wash the cloth and make wudhu. Thus whatever salah you have offered in this state it is also wajib to repeat them. However, if the fluid discharged without lust due to some illness then it shall not make ghusl wajib. In such a case, it was enough to wash the cloth and the place where the impurity was smeared, and the salahs offered in this state were valid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
